A working comparison of prebuilt material delivery, CPU authoring and WebGPU compute. Every path uses the same eight-zone building recipe.

What is being measured

The producer bakes all eight zones. GPU synthesis and normal-aware mip filtering run in compute shaders. GPU preview copies results directly into textures; readback is separate and needed only for export or numerical comparison.

Client downloads contain all three maps and their mip chains. Loading includes decompression, checksum verification and GPU upload. Cache Storage is explicit; “Force download” bypasses this lab's cache and browser HTTP cache.

Published demo packs use 256² per zone. Larger bake sizes are different workloads. The first GPU bake includes shader compilation; warm runs reuse pipelines. These are wall-clock measurements on your current adapter, not universal performance claims.

The prototype transport is gzip-compressed RGBA8 with prepared mipmaps. GPU block compression such as KTX2/Basis is a later packaging option.
